{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_clean[(sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the count of completed LOYAL orders for evidence
len(loyal_completed), mean_revenue"}
